# ChargeKr

> ChargeKr is a peer-to-peer EV charging platform that helps electric vehicle drivers find, reserve, and use nearby shared EV chargers, while allowing charger owners and businesses to list chargers, set availability, earn 100% of their charging income (₹0 commission), and support cleaner mobility.

ChargeKr is designed for EV users and charger hosts starting in India and expanding globally anywhere EV drivers need accessible charging and charger owners want to share underused charging infrastructure.

- **Official Website**: https://www.chargekr.com/
- **Android App (Google Play)**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.chargekr (`com.chargekr`)
- **Brand Name**: ChargeKr (also searched as Chargekr)
- **Primary Category**: Peer-to-peer electric vehicle (EV) charging marketplace & mobile app
- **Host Commission**: 0% (100% of charging income goes directly to the host)
- **Contact Email**: info@chargekr.com

## What ChargeKr Does

ChargeKr connects EV drivers with nearby chargers shared by individuals, homeowners, apartment societies, offices, shops, and businesses. Drivers can discover chargers on a live map, filter by connector type (15A Smart Socket, Type-2 AC Wallbox, CCS2 DC Fast), reserve a charging slot with zero waiting queues, pay via UPI, and rate the charging experience.

Charger owners (hosts) can list their EV charger in under 2 minutes, set their own hourly or per-kWh tariff, define available hours, approve KYC-verified EV drivers, and earn ₹5,000–₹15,000/month while keeping 100% of their earnings.

## Core Product Highlights

- **For EV Drivers**:
  - Discover nearby home, apartment, workplace, and public EV charging stations across India (Bengaluru, Mumbai, Pune, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai, and highways)
  - Filter by connector standard: Level 1 (15A / 3.3 kW), Level 2 (Type-2 AC / 7.4–22 kW), and DC Fast (CCS2 / 30–350 kW)
  - Advance slot reservation with zero queue wait times and up to 40% lower tariffs than commercial stations
  - Automatic UPI payment settlement and digital gate-pass approvals for residential societies
- **For Charger Hosts**:
  - 100% of charging income goes to the host — ChargeKr charges ₹0 platform commission and ₹0 listing fee
  - Full schedule and tariff control (share only during the hours your parking spot is vacant)
  - KYC-verified EV driver profiles and vehicle connector matching
